H_definition: longest edge of each affine background tetrahedron
scope: Only the generated arterial terminal set and 4245 affine background cells. By convexity and 1-Lipschitz nearest-set distance, d(centroid)+max_vertex_distance<=2H certifies every point in the cell, hence also any Q2 quadrature point. This is not replay of native distributed routing or quadrature. No PV/HV/triple, finer-mesh, perfusion or inf-sup claim. Shared-face cell assignment for occupancy is not unique.
